nodes.Name: PendingContinue
nodes.DocComment:
PendingContinue holds a planned-but-unapproved continuation between the review
and the approve/reject call.

nodes.Name: ContinueReview
nodes.DocComment: ContinueReview is the SSE payload the Studio renders for Approve/Reject.

Fields.Name: AutoOK
Fields.DocComment: true → no conflicts, safe to proceed

nodes.Name: ReviewEntity
nodes.DocComment: ReviewEntity is one existing entity in the review.

nodes.Name: StartContinue
nodes.DocComment:
StartContinue plans a continuation and either proceeds (autoApprove or no
conflicts) or publishes a review and holds. target empty → server root.

nodes.Name: runContinue
nodes.DocComment: runContinue does the plan + review; on auto/approve it generates.

nodes.Name: ApproveContinue
nodes.DocComment: ApproveContinue generates the held plan. Returns an error if none is pending.

nodes.Name: generateContinue
nodes.DocComment: generateContinue runs the agent on the delta plan and finishes the job.

nodes.Name: buildContinueReview
nodes.DocComment: buildContinueReview assembles the SSE review payload.
